hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: A bonding-curve token launchpad hook that deploys new ERC-20 tokens into Uniswap v4 pools with a structured liquidity curve. Blocks external pool initialization and liquidity additions. Charges a 1% swap fee split equally between the token creator and the platform. When a token's bonding curve supply is exhausted, automatically removes liquidity and migrates the token to a standard full-range AMM pool.
